headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to make their vehicle fleets and transportation more fuel-efficient.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets goals for federal agencies to use fuel more efficiently in their vehicle fleets and other transportation. No summary was provided, so specific targets, deadlines, and requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that operate vehicle fleets
who_it_affects.how: They would be expected to change how they buy, use, or fuel government vehicles to improve efficiency.
